unit: Algebra · Chapter 1. Systems of linear equations

stages.headline: When we need the common solutions of two equations, we have a system of equations, written with a brace.
stages.headlineEnglish: When we need the common solutions of two equations, we have a system of equations, written with a brace.

stages.headline: A pair (x; y) solves the system if it satisfies both equations.

stages.headline: To solve a system means to find all its solutions or to prove it has none.
